source.label: Source
source.sdrNote: This RGB source exports in SDR. For an HDR video, pick “Video from the fractal” or a recolorable source, then Dynamic range → HDR.

path.title: Path
path.sameCenter: Same center along the whole path.
path.movingCenter: The center moves between the two positions.
path.timingPriorityNote: The last edited value (duration or speed) keeps priority when the range changes.
path.summary: {frames} frames · {seconds} s total. The current appearance is used along the whole path.

output.title: Output
output.hdrNote: Rec.2020 / PQ · reference white 203 nits. Independent of HDR display. The 10-bit profile is checked at startup, with no SDR fallback. Compression follows the profile selected above.

quality.title: Quality
quality.budgetNote: The device's conservative memory budget is indicative: the export may exceed it if the GPU accepts the allocation.
quality.thresholdNote: Swap threshold: a low value reconverges more often; a high value favors speed. Texture limit: {limit}.

export.title: Export
export.scope: Each frame is computed to convergence
export.noHdrEncoder: No 10-bit HDR encoder available for this choice in this browser.
export.noEncoder: No encoder available for this choice.
